instant.$description: Near-immediate feedback — press states, toggles. Below this a change reads as a jump.

fast.$description: Quick UI transitions — icon rotation, chevrons, sidebar collapse.

base.$description: Default transition speed — fades, stroke/progress animations.

slow.$description: Entrance transitions for larger surfaces — sheet/drawer open.

enter.$description: Decelerate — an element entering the screen or a surface opening.

exit.$description: Accelerate — an element leaving the screen or a surface closing.

emphasized.$description: Expressive — large or attention-drawing transitions. Use sparingly.
